style: Repaint this plain flat 3D render as a finished hand-painted pixel-art sprite for an isometric strategy game: {subject}. The picture holds separate views of the same subject; keep every view exactly where it is, with exactly the same shape, pose, size, proportions and camera angle. Add crisp dark outlines, painted panel lines, seams, small equipment details and light weathering; clear light from the upper left with darker shaded sides; muted military colours. Same plain flat solid light grey background, no ground, no cast shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no flags, no insignia.
